# Manas v0.1.0 — The First Real Version

> *The demo that matters.*

This is the first version of Manas v2 where knowledge lives in neural network weights,
not in a text file.

## What This Proves

```bash
# teach 22 facts
./manas teach "A cat is a small domesticated animal with fur and whiskers."
# ... 21 more facts ...

# delete all text files — neural weights only
rm -f brain.manas.sources brain.manas.sourceindex

# ask — answered from neural weights, not a text file
./manas ask "What is a cat?"
# Answer: small domesticated animal fur whiskers
# Answered from: neural weights ✅
```

This is the test Manas v1 failed. v0.1.0 passes it.

## What's Inside

- Associative memory engine — knowledge stored in neural weights
- Anti-forgetting system — protection levels enforced in `apply_gradients()`
- Character n-gram tokenizer — structural similarity between related words
- Positional embeddings — word order matters
- Growth system — network grows new neurons when needed
- `.manas` binary format — one file, CRC32 checksum, no sidecars
- `manas teach` — teach raw text, files, and folders
- `manas ask` — answered from neural weights directly
- `manas inspect` — full brain state visibility

## Install

```bash
# Linux x86_64
curl -fsSL https://github.com/AarambhDevHub/manas/releases/latest/download/manas-linux-x86_64.tar.gz \
  | tar -xz && sudo mv manas-linux-x86_64 /usr/local/bin/manas
```

## Build from Source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/AarambhDevHub/manas.git
cd manas
cargo build --workspace --release
./target/release/manas --help
```

## Honest Claim

> Manas v0.1.0 can teach facts into neural network weights and retrieve them
> from weights alone — with no text sidecar, no keyword search, and no internet.
> It is an experimental research project, not a production AI system.
